HOW TO USE THIS ORDINANCE WHAT REGULATIONS APPLY TO MY PROPERTY? STEP 1: Find your property on the Official Zoning Map and note your zoning district and any overlay districts or historic districts that apply. STEP 2: Look in the Use Table in Article 5 for uses that are allowed in your zoning district. The use tables state whether a use is permitted by right, permitted subject to specific use standards, allowed as a conditional use granted by the Board of Adjustments, or prohibited. STEP 3: Look up any overlay zones that apply to your site in Article 4, Zoning Districts. These may include the Historic Overlay District, or Flood District (F) overlays. See Article 4, Zoning Districts, for details. STEP 4: Look in the dimensional standards table in Article 4 for the development standards (lot size, required yards, etc.) that apply to your zoning district. WHERE CAN I LOCATE A PARTICULAR USE?

1 BOWLING GREEN & WARREN COUNTY PERMITTING RESOURCE GUIDE Thank you for choosing Bowling Green (BG) and Warren County (WC) for your development. Once you determine in which jurisdiction your project falls, this guide will help you contact the appropriate parties for assistance and guidance through the process. BUILDING DIVISION The Building and Inspection Division issues building and electrical permits for all new construction, remodeling with structural and occupancy use changes. Fields inspections are made to ensure that the work is done within the minimum guidelines set forth by all applicable codes. The Division is also responsible for reviewing the plans submitted by contractors, architects or owners for all structures for design compliance with the requirements of the Kentucky Building Code.
